cartographic_sources.survey: IGN BD TOPO V3 piste_d_aerodrome / batiment, queried 2026-10-06; complete 1045-building pagination
cartographic_sources.notes: Surveyed main pavement and buildings. Z absent from IGN: schematic 12.5 m connector positioned from ADC. Runway 2627 x 45 m; published usable distances 2487 m. Runway paint schematic, aiming marks 300 m from thresholds. IGN orthophoto is blurred: not used to invent detail. Old stand labels 1-13 lay in surveyed grass islands and are not identified on ADC: replaced with published P1-P5/ZA/H1-H4 names. No yellow guidance lines or illuminated stop bars.
